perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: The September 14 approximately $60 million USAF proximity-sensor production award remains a current production-demand signal, with explicit capacity expansion language.
Fresh review also retains the September 3 completion of the first 35 Viper Shield systems and ramp toward 233 systems on order as a materially different production-conversion datapoint.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Awards and systems on order improve demand visibility; completed initial Viper Shield production is stronger execution evidence than award value alone.
The remaining test is full-rate production, delivery cadence, margins and working-capital/capex conversion across ramps.

sources.use: current production contract and capacity evidence

lineage.searchStrategy: fresh issuer-domain review emphasizing production conversion rather than award headlines
